facts.weird: Everyone launches memecoins. The KOLs live on the Hill and retail lives down in the Flats
facts.who: Ollie, a kid who can see which trades win and has to hide it, his best friend Milo, Mrs. Pearl next door, the Whale and his Callers up on the Hill, and the Bots
facts.night: Every window glows with a chart. The Flats go red. The Hill stays green
